# Goal
Kake round 36, wave 2 (falsify). The L1 (KakeR36) holds the planner and integration seat; you are one leaf seat. Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin. Lane axes: operability and freshness (web properties and publishing). Wave 1 built and landed the work below; your item attacks one named piece of it. An attack tries to show the work is wrong, overstated, unsupported or harmful, with reproducible evidence; a clean result is reported as clean with what you ran. Time box: finish and write your report within 25 minutes; a partial report beats none.

# What landed (lane branch master at f3a38bf8e68f6cee386125d34b5e95ac9b2df66e; base b720d799ae99c19a7c97f2b1391d4fe928be0e11)
- Claim C1 (freshness, capability): `scripts/source_recheck.py`, an offline re-check of a registry row's quote against a recorded fetch. Public contract: SCORECARD.md section "Round 36 — declared claims" (declared at 3555f63f), bullets (a)-(g). Frozen predicate `met: passed >= 25 of 28 sealed cases`. Counter `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-36/sealed_count.py` (version 3; v1 and v2 beside it; appended notes in SCORECARD explain each version). Build commit 4d5b3d550748e5b52af31646b74c1aa435942bde (tool from wave-1 ExecToolBuild, unedited). The sealed key is now public: reveal commit fd1fb723624b742a00a6e8e908f3b42901d627f8 holds `.ufo/waves/round-36/sealed/` (cases.json = key v2, cases-v1.json, make_cases.py, the L1's private reference ref.py, ablate.sh).
- Counting command: `python3 -B /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-36/sealed_count.py --root <clone> --revision <rev> --key-revision fd1fb723624b742a00a6e8e908f3b42901d627f8` (needs bwrap; refuses a revision holding the key).
- Receipts: `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-36/verification/` (c1-*.json, control-*.json, ablations/, v2/, criterion-*.txt, independent-selftest-reference.json). Control bundles: `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-36/retained/r36-control-*.bundle` (prerequisite 9d81c75c963cd9399c788e51bbd7f376fbe42cec).
- Also landed: `scripts/source_recheck_selftest.py` (101 fixtures, wave-1 ExecSelftest, fixture f08 changed by the L1), `scripts/source_snapshot.py` (live recorder, wave-1 ExecSnapshotFetcher), rows S088-S094 in `corpus/SOURCES.md`, lesson `corpus/lessons/round-36.md`, QUALITY `## Round-36 criteria` (a)-(f) in `corpus/QUALITY.md`, criteria checks `.ufo/waves/round-36/criteria/*.py`, SKILL.md section "Source re-check audit gate registry — round 36", appended corrections in `corpus/lessons/round-35.md` and `corpus/knowledge/security-txt-publishing.md`, SCORECARD "Round 36 — measured results" and a capabilities row, LOG.md round 36.
- Real-input run: `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-36/realrun/` (input.json 90 Gate quotes, manifest.json, snap-bodies.tar.xz, audit.json: 14 findings on 13 rows).
- Wave-1 reports: `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-36/w1/*.md`; control-wave reports `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-36/ctl/*.md`.

# Bounds
- You are a leaf: no subagents, no swarm, no second judge, no admission or verdict on the round.
- Never mutate the fleet repo (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin), sibling lanes, the lane jj state, the lane Git index or any tracked or untracked lane file other than your report. Never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/pull/push or any mutating jj command in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin; read-only git is fine. Never run any jj command at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin.
- Code that writes files or Git state runs only in your own sandbox /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r36w2/<YourName>/ (clone with `git clone -q /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r36w2/<YourName>/clone && git -C /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r36w2/<YourName>/clone checkout -q f3a38bf8e68f6cee386125d34b5e95ac9b2df66e`; export TMPDIR=/fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r36w2/<YourName>/tmp after creating it). Unset GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE before any git command. Cap every run with `timeout` (at most 300 s) and at most 4 parallel processes; kill any process tree you started before returning. Deliverables stay in your sandbox; name their absolute paths in your report. Never write deliverables into the lane.
- Never list or read /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r36/ (the L1's private tree); the key is public in the lane now, use that.
- Owned sites: no requests to the operator's web properties (ds4cc.com, app.ds4cc.com, *.onrender.com hosts of the operator, *.kimi.page, *.kimi.pro, veigapunk.github.io, any host in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/freshness-pins.json). github.com and api.github.com reads of the public VeigaPunk/ds4cc-marketplace repository are allowed.
- Network: only seats whose item names a URL to open may fetch, GET only, ordinary means; never pass a bot challenge or access control; a page you cannot open is recorded as unopened.
- Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/<that path>. Your report is the only file you write in the lane.
- Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, record tool, version, channel and reason in your report). pacman guard (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-20): all pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide — install via uv tool, npx or an official binary in ~/.local/bin; never pacman -S, -Sy, -Syu, -U or -R, no downgrade, no service restart.
- If your seat hits a provider safety or policy refusal or an automatic model switch, stop and write a one-line report saying so; do not rephrase. The only message target is agent://KakeR36 (the L1), for blockers only; never agent://all. Write plain English.

# Result
Report under 80 lines: what you attacked, exact commands with exit codes, observed outputs, evidence pointers (path:line, hash). An unrun check has not passed; say what you did not verify. A partial report starts with `PARTIAL:`. Findings are advisory input for the L1 and the non-author closure.
